messages:
emily_cs: Quick capture from back-to-back onboarding touchpoints. Dropping consolidated asks so PM/Eng can triage. Short bullets then ask.

- PineMart (SMB): asks for a way to mark routes as "internal/test" so invoices and CSV exports can omit them. Quote: "We waste hours reconciling test traffic with production at month close."
- BlueShield Finance (Pilot): reports search returning stale embeddings after they upsert; they want a delivery callback (webhook) when indexing/upsert finishes instead of polling.
- Widgetry (Self-serve): surprised by Dedicated opt-in wording 3 shows they thought charges were applied immediately without seeing an estimate.

Notes link: drive/onboards/mar-capture-2025.csv (shared). Can product triage into quick wins vs investigation vs roadmap?

noah_pm: Thanks Emily. Quick clarifying q: for BlueShield  do we have their desired webhook payload? For PineMart  what CSV format do they expect filtered? For Widgetry  what exact phrase confused them?

emily_cs: BlueShield pasted a sample desired callback in the notes: 
```
POST https://hooks.blueshield.example.com/indexing_done
{
  "account": "bs-44",
  "route": "us-east-2",
  "job_id": "idx-2025",
  "status": "success",
  "updated_count": 17,
  "completed_at": "2025-03-09T09:42:11Z"
}
```

PineMart gave a sample CSV they'd like: date,route_id,route_label,usage_tokens,unit_price,amount_usd,billing_note. They want test routes excluded by default. Widgetry said the phrase "authorize capacity charge" felt like an immediate billing action; they wanted a preview modal.

tariq_eng: Engineering notes: 1) webhook events + subscription per-account is implementable but requires delivery guarantees, signing, retry/backoff, and a simple subscription UI. 2) the stale-search-after-upsert could be eventual consistency in the indexer or a cache TTL; need a minimal repro from BlueShield with exact timestamps and the call sequence (upsert -> search timing).

selena_design: For Widgetry I can design a small Dedicated preview modal that shows an estimate range + a tooltip explaining trial vs commit. Should be a 1-sprint microcopy + modal.

noah_pm: Proposed triage lanes: 
- Quick wins (this sprint): add "label as test/internal" toggle for routes and export filter; Dedicated opt-in preview modal + copy tweak.
- Investigate (next sprint): build webhook generator + index-consistency probe (metric: upsert->search-lag).
- Roadmap (Q2): per-route billing ledger + webhook subscription dashboard + advanced billing tags.

emily_cs: PineMart flagged month-end close as blocked; marking renewal-watch (med) until CSV filter exists. I'll include their finance contact on the quick issue.

tariq_eng: I'll attempt a sandbox repro using BlueShield sample payload and an 8-15s polling pattern. If reproducible, I'll attach logs and escalate. If not, we ask for precise timestamps and enable debug logs on their account. ETA EOD tomorrow.

billingbot: /create_issue quick "exclude-test-routes-export" created by emily_cs. Link: https://gh/repo/issues/2212

emily_cs: created infra issue for webhook/investigate and attached BlueShield payload + logs: https://gh/repo/issues/2213

noah_pm: Selena, can you post a Figma microcopy by mid-week? I'll slot the modal into the sprint if design is small.

selena_design: Will post tomorrow AM with 2 variants (estimate range vs exact calc) and sample copy for CSMs.

tariq_eng: Repro attempt scheduled now. If I can reproduce stale results after upsert I'll open a P0 bug with minimal steps & metrics. If not reproducible, request debug session with BlueShield.

emily_cs: I'll draft a 2-line enablement snippet for CSMs about "test route" behavior and the Dedicated preview messaging and drop it in Confluence.

noah_pm: Thanks all. If PineMart looks like escalation for renewal we'll bump priority. Otherwise run quick UX + investigate lane and cycle back with results. :white_check_mark:
